start: Gym tab, My gym part; the gym's server has 0069; online

steps.action: Tap the row 'Message your gym' ('Ask a question, share feedback or make a complaint')
user_sees: Page 'Message your gym'
'What is it about?' with 'Question', 'Feedback', 'Complaint'
'The owner, front desk and trainers at <gym> read your question.'
must_not: The 'A trainer' choice for a member whose plan has ended

steps.action: Type 'Is the gym open on Diwali?' and tap 'Send message'
user_sees: 'Sent. When your gym replies, you will see it below.'
The message at the top of 'Your messages' with 'Not seen by your gym yet. Waiting for a reply.'
must_not: The message sent twice
The typed words lost on a failed send

steps.action: The desk replies in the panel; later the member opens the Gym tab
user_sees: A red count '1' on the row and 'Your gym replied. Tap to read it.'
must_not: No count after a reply
A count for a reply already read

steps.action: Tap the row
user_sees: The reply under the question, '<name> from your gym'; the red count goes
must_not: The count staying after the page was opened

steps.action: Pick 'Complaint'
user_sees: 'Only the owner of <gym> reads your complaint. The front desk and trainers do not see it.'
must_not: The complaint reaching a trainer, even when picked under a trainer

steps.action: Pick 'Feedback', tick 'Send without my name', send
user_sees: 'Your gym can still reply here, but it will not see who sent it.'
The sent line tagged 'Sent without your name'
must_not: The member's name or number shown to the gym on anonymous feedback

steps.action: Tap the notification
user_sees: The 'Message your gym' page with the reply
must_not: The Gym tab home instead of the page
A trainer's page for a gym reply

start: Gym server has 0096; the member wants a trainer to answer

steps.action: Pick 'Question', then under 'Who should read it?' pick one trainer by name
user_sees: 'Only the person you pick sees your question.'
must_not: The question seen by every trainer

steps.action: Send
user_sees: 'Sent. …' and the question in the list
must_not: The question sent to the owner instead

steps.action: Tap 'Send message' with the box empty
user_sees: A red line asking to write something
must_not: An empty message sent

steps.action: Paste 1,200 letters
user_sees: The counter '1000 of 1000 letters' and the text stopped there
must_not: 1,200 letters sent, or cut with no word

steps.action: Pick 'Question', tick nothing, try to send without the name
user_sees: 'Only feedback can be sent without your name.' when tried
must_not: A question or complaint sent without the name

start: The gym's server has no 0069 (and no trainer side)

steps.action: Open the Gym tab
user_sees: No 'Message your gym' row
must_not: A row that leads to a page that cannot send

start: A question was sent and the gym replied and marked it done

steps.action: Open the page
user_sees: The reply under the question
'Your gym marked this as done. Write back if you need more help.'
must_not: The thread lost after done

steps.action: Write back on the done thread
user_sees: The thread back to 'Not seen by your gym yet. Waiting for a reply.'
must_not: A new thread with the old one hidden
The red count coming back for the member's own words

start: Message your gym page, sending feedback

steps.action: Read the readers line before sending
user_sees: 'Only the owner and front desk at <gym> read your feedback. Your trainers do not see it.'
must_not: A trainer able to read the feedback in their app
MettleUp HQ reading the message

steps.action: Send and wait 180 days
user_sees: The message and replies are deleted after 180 days (privacy notice)
must_not: Messages kept forever
